eval: __game.stop(), 'stopped: Phase 5 design check of the contract stubs (PHASE5.md §8, §9.3)'

expect: !!__game.settings && !!__game.keys && !!__game.quality && !!__game.saves && typeof __game.renderInfo === 'function' && 'the Phase 5 hooks exist'
label: settings, keys, quality, saves and renderInfo on __game

expect: __game.settings.get('sound.volume') === 0.7 && __game.keys.label('squeeze') === 'Q' && __game.keys.label('map') === 'O' && __game.quality.state().shadows === 'high' && 'the defaults keep Phase 4 (the map on O: a new key)'
label: the defaults are Phase 4's game

expect: (() => { const i = __game.renderInfo(); return i.calls > 0 && i.calls <= __game.config.GFX.budget.calls && i.triangles <= __game.config.GFX.budget.triangles && JSON.stringify(i); })()
label: the sandbox view inside the graphics budget

eval: (() => { const s = __game.settings; for (const v of ['low', 'off', 'high', 'auto']) { s.set('graphics.shadows', v); __game.renderNow(); __game.quality.frame(0.016); __game.renderNow(); } return 'shadows low, off, high, auto: ' + JSON.stringify(__game.quality.state()); })()

expect: __game.renderInfo().linked === __l0 && __game.renderer.shadowMap.enabled && __game.renderer.shadowMap.autoUpdate && 'no shader linked by a shadow change: ' + __l0 + ' programs linked'
label: the shadow settings compile no shader (review round, §4.4)

expect: __game.env.dayNumber === -1 && __game.level.mode === 'level' && 'Phase 2 prep day'
label: startLevel({ seed }) is still Phase 2's prep day

expect: __game.ui.openPanelId === 'menu' && __game.ui.panelKind === 'paused' && __game.ui.menu.entries().map((e) => e.id).join(',')
label: Esc with nothing open: the game menu, the clock stopped

expect: document.activeElement?.dataset?.menu === 'map' && __game.ui.openPanelId === 'menu' && 'the menu takes its own arrow keys (panel onKey): ' + document.activeElement.dataset.menu
label: the open panel is offered the key first (the menu's arrows)

expect: __game.ui.openPanelId === 'settings' && __game.ui.parentPanels.join() === 'menu' && 'the settings, the menu waiting under them'
label: the menu opens the settings (frozen hook data-menu) with the menu as its parent

eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#hud [data-setting="sound.volume"] input'); s.value = '0.4'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return __game.settings.get('sound.volume'); })()

expect: Math.abs(__game.audio.settings.volume - 0.4) < 1e-6 && JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('chickenFarm.settings.v1')).values.sound.volume === 0.4 && JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('chicken-farm.sound')).volume === 0.4 && 'volume 0.4 (the slider holds the stored 0..1 value) in the sound, the settings key and the Phase 4 key'
label: a setting applies at once and is remembered

expect: __game.ui.openPanelId === 'menu' && document.activeElement?.dataset?.menu === 'settings' && 'back in the menu, on Settings'
label: Esc in the settings goes back to the menu (the return path)

expect: __game.ui.openPanelId === null && 'closed'
label: Esc closes the menu

expect: __game.ui.openPanelId === null && 'no menu on the press right after a panel closed'
label: the Esc guard: an Escape just after a panel closed opens nothing

eval: window.__p0 = { x: __game.player.position.x, z: __game.player.position.z }, __game.ui.captureNextKey((e) => { window.__cap = e.code; }), 'the next key is captured'

expect: window.__cap === 'KeyW' && Math.hypot(__game.player.position.x - __p0.x, __game.player.position.z - __p0.z) < 0.05 && 'captured KeyW; the farmer did not walk'
label: ui.captureNextKey takes W before the farmer's own keys (the Keys tab's Change)

expect: __game.ui.openPanelId === 'map' && document.querySelectorAll('#hud [data-place]').length >= 40 && 'the farm map with ' + document.querySelectorAll('#hud [data-place]').length + ' places'
label: O opens the map

expect: __game.ui.openPanelId === 'map' && 'Tab moves the focus inside the map; the map stays'
label: Tab is the focus key, not the map's

expect: __game.ui.openPanelId === null && __game.player.walking && 'walking to the silos'
label: a place on the map: the map closes and he walks there

expect: Math.hypot(__game.player.position.x + 18.25, __game.player.position.z + 8.1) < 1.5 && 'at the silo gauge: ' + __game.player.position.x.toFixed(1) + ', ' + __game.player.position.z.toFixed(1)
label: the route finder takes him from the gate to the silos

expect: __game.ui.openPanelId === 'saves' && [...document.querySelectorAll('#hud [data-slot]')].map((r) => r.dataset.slot).join() === 'auto,1,2,3' && 'autosave and three slots'
label: the saves panel lists the autosave and three slots (frozen hook data-slot)

expect: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#hud [data-guide="controls"]')?.textContent || ''; return __game.ui.openPanelId === 'guide' && t.includes('Squeeze') && t.includes('O opens the farm map') && 'the guide with the live keys'; })()
label: How to play shows the key bindings (frozen hook data-guide)

expect: (() => { const ids = [...document.querySelectorAll('#hud [data-title-action]')].map((b) => b.dataset.titleAction); return ['saves', 'settings', 'guide'].every((x) => ids.includes(x)) && 'the title card has ' + ids.join(', '); })()
label: the title card's Phase 5 keys (frozen hook data-title-action)
